# Generated by Alpine's update-raspberrypi-bootloader on every apk transaction
# that touches /boot. It is shipped here as well so that the image boots even
# if the apk trigger did not run (e.g. when the rootfs was assembled from a
# foreign-architecture chroot). The values below are exactly what the trigger
# computes for a 32-bit linux-rpi install, so it will leave them alone.
#
# Do not modify this file, create and/or modify usercfg.txt instead.
# https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/config_txt.html

kernel=vmlinuz-rpi
initramfs initramfs-rpi
arm_64bit=0
include usercfg.txt
